name: How long does storm-related drywall replacement typically take?

mainEntity.name: How long does storm-related drywall replacement typically take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of storm-related drywall replacement depends on the severity and scope of the damage. A small section might take a day or two for removal, drying, and installation, plus additional time for finishing. Larger projects involving multiple rooms, extensive drying, or structural repairs can extend to several days or even weeks. Factors like drying time, material availability, and the contractor's schedule also play a role. Your contractor will provide an estimated timeline during the assessment.
acceptedAnswer.description: The timeline varies from a few days for small areas to several weeks for extensive damage, depending on severity, drying time, and additional repairs needed.
